links.outcome: Agreement with expert gold-standard triage ranking, LLMs versus secretaries and dental assistants
links.effect: AI agreement with expert gold standard Fleiss' κ = 0.572 vs dental assistants κ = 0.249 and secretaries κ = 0.227; GPT-o3 highest weighted κ = 0.681.
links.quote: Artificial intelligence (AI) models demonstrated significantly higher agreement with the expert gold standard (Fleiss' κ = 0.572) compared to dental assistants (κ = 0.249) and secretaries (κ = 0.227).

screen.reason: The study evaluates LLMs against non-clinical administrative staff on hypothetical clinical vignettes for dental clinic triage, benchmarking performance against an expert clinical gold standard without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
